---
name: demo-script
description: Prepare a reproducible 60-second VenturaData demo that proves one implemented analysis capability on a versioned dataset. Use when an executable MVP slice needs a concise demonstration. Do not use when the analysis is unimplemented or depends on private unversioned data.
---

# Demo script

- Use one small reproducible dataset checked into or referenced by the repository.
- Show the input command or API request and generated insight metric or dashboard artifact.
- Include one data-quality or model limitation.
- Keep preprocessing deterministic and visible.
- Avoid claims not supported by the demonstrated dataset and tests.
- Verify every command from a clean checkout before publishing.
